title: Community-Level Daytime Sleepiness: Social-Environmental Determinants, Consequences, and Impact of Sleep Apnea

sections.abstract: The purpose of this study is to examine daytime sleepiness in a community context. This includes examining sleepiness in a large sample in terms of social/behavioral/environmental predictors and health-related outcomes, as well as examining the role of a sleep education intervention in a smaller sample for promoting healthy beliefs/attitudes about sleepiness.
